title: canon.rs: two stale comments, the --force help quoted for .mcp.json and init not seeding AGENTS.md
body:
Two comments in `native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/canon.rs` describe behaviour the code and the CLI no longer have. Found by cc's doc sweep on 2026-09-19. Comment-only, XS, but the change is under a crate and owes the crate suite, so it was not folded into the doc-sweep commit (e12e071d1).

1. The `.mcp.json` block (step 1b) says `--force` "does NOT reach it: that flag's own help names `CLAUDE.md` and `.intent_critic.yml` and stops there". The help now also names `.claude/settings.json` without Intent's hook door (`docs/reference/intent-claude.md:199`). The claim that `--force` does not reach `.mcp.json` still holds; the quoted help does not.
2. The root-files block (step 2) says `init` "deliberately does not seed" `AGENTS.md`. Since the 2026-09-09 ruling, `init` generates it (`init.rs:108-120`, `("llm/_AGENTS.md", Generated("AGENTS.md"))`). The reasoning that `AGENTS.md` is generated by definition still holds; the claim about `init` does not.

Fix: correct both sentences in place, then run the intentsvcs suite.
